interpretationBoundaries: Each optimizer candidate and each per-seed baseline was evaluated once across the three training workloads.
No hand-authored baseline survived the single-evaluation combined Pareto front in any seed.
The five optimizer Pareto members are validation finalists, not confirmed improvements over repeated baselines.
Exact objective values are not merged across seeds because live-cluster timing noise makes equality an invalid stability criterion.
No seed produced at least three unique Pareto points, so no strict interior knee point is reported.
Repeated finalist validation under a shared protocol is required before paper or CFP superiority claims are updated.
